changes.text: BREAK OUT: leave the ISA wrapper and borrow up to 0.5x equity at 5.25% (Bank Rate 3.75% + 1.5%)
changes.rationale: Maximum convexity: margin adds firepower, and outside the ISA the agent can hold bitcoin ETPs and short; it accepts the interest cost and higher risk of elimination
breakout: left the ISA wrapper (shorting, crypto ETNs, US ETFs allowed)

changes.text: Survival rule: close all margin borrowing if total equity falls 25% from its peak; hard stop -20% per position
changes.rationale: Zero funds means losing the game; leverage is only an edge if the agent survives long enough to use it

changes.text: Use borrowed money only for the two strongest momentum exposures
changes.rationale: Leverage on the best trends, not on hope
